verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a developer section with a REST API to access, create and manipulate content using Bearer-token auth, plus an MCP endpoint for building custom apps, agents or bots against a space. That supports external integrations, but nothing shows an in-app plugin or extension system, an SDK, or sample code, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: in-app plugin/extension API, official SDK, code samples or example plugins, published OpenAPI/reference spec, independent developer corroboration.
